title: A two-qubit cell on the basis of boron nitride nanotubes for the quantum computer
abstract: We represent the results of quantum chemical calculations of boron nitride nanotubes intercalated by alkali and alkali-earth metall atoms and its ions. It was obtained that unpair spins were localized on seperated metal atoms. So we propose to construct the two-qubit cells on the basis of infilled boron nitride nanotubes for the quantum computer.
